svg.title: Enterprise GenAI Platform Architecture
svg.desc: Sanitized architecture showing enterprise use cases, AWS application and GPU model-serving EKS clusters, document ingestion, retrieval stores, Vertex AI Gemini, GitOps delivery and SRE ownership.
svg.text: AI ingestion, inference & tooling SRE + Distributed Systems SME
Venkata Ganji | Platform engineering and production ownership | Sanitized portfolio architecture
A APPLICATION EKS | INGESTION + INFERENCE SERVICES
DATA SERVICES | LOGICAL BACKENDS; PLACEMENT VARIES BY SERVICE
Tenant-aware access | request routing | application integrations
Business use cases and source scope
Platform events / configuration distribution; asynchronous coordination shown logically
Safety / moderation | authorization | OPA policy manifests
FSx for Lustre PVC; read-only serving mounts
GPU resources / tensor parallelism / LoRA serving
3 SOLR INFRASTRUCTURE [C] | AUTHORED + OWNED END TO END
EC2 instances, EBS storage, ENIs and security groups
IAM / KMS integration and host bootstrapping
Environment-specific deployment and AMI refresh tooling
Ansible roles for Solr 8 / 9 and ZooKeeper
JDK / ARM support, JVM settings and TLS / ACL setup
Solr + node exporters; logs and metrics configuration
AZ-aware replica placement and add / remove utilities
Serial rolling restarts with recovery-status checks
Replica-transition tooling for cluster / node migrations
Personal ownership: Solr IaC and lifecycle tooling. Built on shared cloud modules and open-source components.
Image policies / update automation / deployment alerts
Kubernetes configuration, service routing and release diagnosis
Model values + reusable Helm charts -> Argo CD
Custom image builds -> artifact loader -> checksum verification
GPU sizing, runtime parameters and model API registration
Shared-weight lifecycle, probes and Prometheus ServiceMonitor
Prometheus / Grafana metrics + Splunk logs -> alerts
Capacity, JVM/GC, query/index and storage performance
Incident diagnosis, backups, recovery and migration tooling
Identity, secret integration and workload policy controls
AI platform SRE | Distributed systems SME | Mission-critical migrations | End-to-end deployment tooling
Logical composite of production deployment families; not a claim that every service ran in one physical cluster or one release.
Application/model separation, Strimzi placement and internal-model hosting include user-confirmed context. Names, endpoints, tenant IDs and secrets are generalized.
